subject: prd/implement-now
statement: Every configured green proposal captures one durable obligation at the verified revision before its EVT-10; that task's claim and width slot release before review admission; no sweep-end head re-read occurs; one invocation launches at most one uniquely identified attempt and deduplicates concurrent/repeated starts.
fit_criterion: executable green→persist→EVT-10→release→launch ordering trace, moving-head fixture, obligation persistence/recovery record, crash-point matrix, duplicate-invocation fixture, and distinct retry-attempt identities
